title: X_explotion Utils
description: Utility mod for X_explotion's other mods!
body:
# X_explotion Utils

**X_explotion Utils** is a lightweight utility library for X_explotion's Fabric mods, providing shared tools, helpers, and abstractions to simplify mod development.

## ✨ Features

- Easy Config

- More planned

If you find any bugs please report them to @X_explotion on discord!
